Driven by a passion for bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI and practical clinical application, I'm focused on building tools that empower healthcare professionals to confidently utilize and interpret AI-driven diagnostics.  My background in explainable AI, honed through doctoral research at Stanford, allows me to address critical concerns around trust and transparency in medical AI.  Currently, I'm leading Synapse Insights through seed funding, building a strong team, and refining our core platform for initial clinical trials.
